title: UCI 360 Air Quality (gas multisensor array with reference analyser), Italian city, 2004-2005
summary: Single CSV of hourly averaged readings from a road-level air-quality chemical multisensor device in an unnamed Italian city, with co-located certified reference analyser values for CO, NMHC, benzene, NOx and NO2, plus five metal-oxide sensor responses and temperature, relative humidity and absolute humidity. The sample covers 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 with about 9,357 rows (the whole file was read). It is a one-off research dataset, not a live feed, and has no traffic counts or clinic data.

quality_notes: UCI declares has_missing_values='no' and missing_values_symbol=null, yet the notes say missing values are coded -200 and the sample has them in most columns. Treat -200 as missing.

Missingness varies by column in the sample: NMHC(GT) 9.8% populated (8,443 cells = -200); NOx(GT) and NO2(GT) about 82.5% populated (about 1,640 cells each = -200); CO(GT) 83% populated (1,592 = -200); the sensor columns, T, RH and AH about 96.1% populated (366 cells each = -200).

C6H6(GT) shows 100% non-missing and no sentinel count, but 366 values equal -200 (counted as negatives). The -200 sentinel is therefore not flagged on this column and would pass a naive missing-value filter. Also CO(GT) has 91 negative values that are not -200 and need a check.
Temperature T has 13 negative values in the sample (min -1.9 °C). Plausible for winter, but check against the sentinel.
Date span conflict: the UCI notes say recordings run 'March 2004 to February 2005', but the file's dates run from 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04. The data itself is the better guide for coverage.
Row count conflict: UCI metadata gives 9,358 instances; the sample read 9,357 data rows (the whole file, sample_is_whole_file=true). Likely a header or counting difference, not verified.

The city is not named in the UCI documentation. The page describes only 'an Italian city' and a road-level, significantly polluted site. Location cannot be confirmed from this source, so it cannot be matched to Valdena.
Reference values are from one co-located analyser at one site. The sensor columns are uncalibrated and affected by drift and cross-sensitivity (per the UCI notes citing De Vito et al. 2008).

Coverage gaps for the use case: no vehicle traffic (N2), no respiratory clinic data (N4/N5), no PM2.5 or PM10 (N1 asks for NO2 or PM2.5; NO2 is present), and no annual PM2.5 deaths context (N6). Only the prototype window is covered, and only by this file.
Time field is documented as HH.MM.SS but parsed as H:00:00 in the sample. Harmless but needs a parser that accepts both.

Licence conflict: CC BY 4.0 on the page versus research-only, commercial use excluded in the notes. Commercial use cannot be confirmed; treat as not cleared for commercial use until the owner or UCI confirms.
